similar.what: Copy detection by shared three-word sequences, tested on edited copies of real texts.
caveats: The copies are made by this script, not collected from a real campaign.
Rewording by hand or by an AI changes most three-word sequences, so reworded copies are missed. The rows above show where that starts.
This tests the comparison only. Whether Bluesky search returns the copies in the first place is not measured.

techniques.what: Technique detection compared with human labels, one text at a time.

detector.model: set on the server (AI_ROUTER_MODEL); not visible to this script

caveats: The labelled texts are political memes from 2020-2021, not Bluesky posts or video transcripts.
The labels are for the meme's text alone (Subtask 1 of the task). This tool does not read images, so the task's image-and-text labels are not used.
Annotators disagree with each other on technique labels too; a miss or an extra flag is not always the detector being wrong.
Techniques with fewer than 10 labelled examples are listed but their numbers are too uncertain to rely on.
The neutral set is 32 factual posts from 8 automated feeds; ordinary personal posts are not in it.
